derivation.method: Manual application of the written caller-error-test contract to xcrun objdump disassembly, with transcription of words, addresses and instruction windows. No AIRS implementation or analysis output was used.
derivation.symbol_and_throws_source: expected.json: stub_calls and independent demangler record
derivation.precall_rule: Only exact 0xaa1f03f5 counts; MOVZ X21, #0 and restoration from an alias do not. No site has the exact zero within four words.
derivation.postcall_rule: Stop at the first unsupported instruction; a later textual alias test is not a recovered test. Tail B sites have no post-call window.
derivation.boundary_assumption: A four-word search truncated by the caller start and containing no zero is precall_window_outside_caller.
derivation.denominator_note: 27 imported Swift sites include two tail B sites and 25 BL sites; seven BL sites are declared throwing.
